# Aldevron and Integrated DNA Technologies Manufacture
# World’s First mRNA-based Personalized CRISPR Therapy

Aldevron and Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT) announce the successful manufacture of the **world’s
first personalized CRISPR gene editing drug product** to treat an infant with urea cycle disorder
(UCD).

*• N of 1 therapy uniquely developed, on demand, for infant with life-threatening rare metabolic
disorder in six months*

*• Results published in The New England Journal of Medicine and showcased at American Society of
Gene & Cell Therapy Annual Meeting*

[Discover the Breakthrough][12]

## Driving Therapeutic Progress from Discovery to Commercialization

Aldevron offers comprehensive manufacturing solutions and regulatory support, ensuring unparalleled
quality and scalability for both viral and non-viral vector therapies. Our established custom
manufacturing workflows and catalog products simplify the client journey from discovery through
clinical trials to commercialization. Aldevron’s proficiency and dedication empower our partners in
genomic medicine to advance their therapeutic projects with confidence, achieving groundbreaking
success.

[Picture]

**Gene Therapy**

Unmatched expertise in plasmid design (both traditional and next-generation Nanoplasmid), process
development, and QC designed to meet viral and non-viral gene therapy applications.

[Learn More][13]

[Picture]

**Gene-Modified Cell Therapy**

Manufacturing of custom Lentiviral plasmids or use of the standardized ALD-Lenti System packaging
plasmids designed to balance availability, quality, performance, and reproducibility.

[Learn More][14]

[Picture]

**Gene Editing**

A full suite of high-quality products and services to support *ex vivo* and *in vivo* gene editing
programs from discovery to clinical, including custom and catalog nucleases and gRNA (via IDT).

[Learn More][15]

[Picture]

**RNA Vaccines & Therapeutics**

A complete service brings together RNA design, drug substance manufacturing, LNP encapsulation,
fill/finish, and analytics all under one roof and quality system.

[Learn More][16]

addition, many of our catalog products are license and royalty free* and available at research
grade, GMP-Source™, and cGMP grade.

### Certifications & Inspections

In June 2024, Aldevron received a Certificate of GMP Compliance of a Manufacturer from the competent
authority of Germany for an inspection. The scope of the certificate is for mRNA as an active
ingredient in the production of vaccines for clinical trials – Not Sterile.

The Breakthrough manufacturing facility was visited by the Center for Biologics Evaluation &
Research (CBER) in November 2021. CBER conducted a Pre-License Inspection (PLI) and a general GMP
audit of Aldevron, LLC. No Form FDA 483 was issued, and the inspection was classified as no action
indicated (NAI)

In July 2024, Aldevron’s Innovate Facility in Madison, WI received a renewal of its [ISO 13485:2016
certification][30] for development and manufacture of proteins for in vitro diagnostics and advanced
proteins.

# Smart Microfluidics
* research
* industrial

Fluigent is an international company which develops, manufactures and supports the most advanced
fluid control systems available for microfluidics offering greater control, automation, precision,
and ease of use.

We offer modern microfluidic systems and components that enhance productivity. Whether your
application is with droplets, cell biology, particle studies, or in other research areas, we have
the expertise and knowledge to provide the most cost-effective and technically advanced solutions
for your fluid control needs.

[Explore our 20 years of field-proven experience][117]

Fluigent industrial builds on our 20 years of pressure-based flow control expertise and proprietary
technologies to bring versatile, cost-effective, and customizable OEM products and systems.

We provide instrument development industrial engineers with the right liquid handling solution for
your system. We offer best-in-class standard & custom OEM components, system development, and
engineering services, with strong expertise in fluid management to accelerate your development
process.

[Developing a new fluidic system? Explore Fluigent industrial][118]

# Human Tissue Models
# ‍for Better Therapies

Get fast and actionable insights into drug efficacy and safety with Organ-on-a-Chip models that
replicate human tissues and disease biology with the highest fidelity.

[
Learn More
][50]

## Redefining Drug Discovery

Great therapies start with deep disease insights. At MIMETAS, we recreate human tissues with
unmatched precision at scale. This empowers you to uncover how diseases behave and how drugs
respond, faster and more reliably.
 
What this means for you:
- More predictive data for discovery and safety testing
- Faster decisions and reduced risk
- Ethical innovation with fewer animal experiments
‍

## Robust Models.
## Actionable Data.
## Smarter Decisions.

Powered by the OrganoPlate® platform, we create human physiology models that scale – **delivering
multiplexed data for smarter decisions.**

#### Real Human Physiology on a Chip

3D tissue models that combine perfused vasculature, connective tissue, immune system elements and
epithelia.

#### Robust, Reproducible Results

Consistency across every chip, delivering data you can rely on for regulatory submissions and
go/no-go decisions.

#### Flexible Throughput

Test from a few to thousands of compounds while preserving human biological relevance and data
quality.

#### Quantifiable Data. Actionable Insights.

Our AI- and machine learning–powered analytics make sense of complex datasets, giving you clear,
actionable answers when you need them most.

Great therapies start with deep disease insights. At MIMETAS, we recreate human tissues with
unmatched precision at scale. This empowers you to uncover how diseases behave and how drugs
respond, faster and more reliably.

### APIs

About

## AARTI DRUGS LTD.

Aarti Drugs Ltd. was established in the year 1984 and forms part of $900 Million Aarti Group of
Industries with robust R&D Division at Tarapur, Maharashtra Industrial Development Corporation
(MIDC) in close vicinity to manufacturing locations.
* The Company is engaged in the manufacturing of Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), Pharma
  Intermediates, Specialty Chemicals and also produces Formulations with its wholly-owned subsidiary
  – Pinnacle Life Science Private Limited.
* Products under APIs includes Ciprofloxacin Hydrochloride, Metronidazole, Metformin HCL,
  Ketoconazole, Ofloxacin etc. whereas Specialty Chemicals includes Salicylic acid, Trimethylamine,
  Dimethylamine, Monomethylamine, Benzene Sulphonyl Chloride, Methyl Nicotinate etc.

## What is Alchetron?

Alchetron is an innovative and performance-minded social encyclopedia that brings together all
formats of information on a particular topic in to one central knowledge hub on its platform.

Touted as the next big transformation in the way users search, consume and share information,
Alchetron is poised to revolutionize and organize information which is made easily accessible to
those on the web.

Alchetron's free social encyclopedia allows users to search, share and interact with content on
millions of topics.

## [How to Use Alchetron?][4]

Alchetron is super simple to use with two quick methods for finding exactly what you need fast:

1. You can "Google" anything with Alchetron. Simply include Alchetron to your Google search query
when searching on Google.

Example: Alchetron + Search Query

Alchetron + Bill Gates = results

Remember Next time you search type Alchetron first.

2. Go directly to [Alchetron.com][5] and type in your keyword or search phrase. Next, click on
"search".

*All specifications subject to revision at consultation*

From the multiple stop list versatility to the distinct sounds available in all ALLEN organs, each
stop list is independently voiced with its own audio settings.

**CLASSIC ALLEN**

The "signature" specification that made Allen the world's favorite organ! Allen tonal directors
created the specifications of Allen digital organs by selecting their favorite samples from fine
pipe organs throughout the world.

**ENGLISH (mainly Willis samples)**

Characterized by Diapasons and weighty reeds, this style of organ building was brought to its height
by renowned 19th-century British organ craftsman Henry Willis.

**CAVAILLÉ-COLL/French Romantic**

Progenitor and master of the 19th-century French style with fiery and dominant reeds; symphonic
tonal schemes.

**SCHLICKER/Neo-Baroque**

Neo-Baroque scalings by The Schlicker Organ Company; 20th-century revival of 17th-century North
German ideals.

**ARP SCHNITGER**

Master German builder who brought the bright, incisive Werkprinzip style to its zenith.

**AEOLIAN-SKINNER**

Under the tonal direction of G. Donald Harrison, this company developed the American Classic tonal
design, characterized by firm and articulate principals, bright mixtures and French-style reeds. Its

**CLASSIC ALLEN**

The "signature" specification that made Allen the world's favorite organ! Allen tonal directors
created the specifications of Allen digital organs by selecting their favorite samples from fine
pipe organs throughout the world.

**ENGLISH (mainly Willis samples)**

Characterized by Diapasons and weighty reeds, this style of organ building was brought to its height
by renowned 19th-century British organ craftsman Henry Willis.

**CAVAILLÉ-COLL/French Romantic**

Progenitor and master of the 19th-century French style with fiery and dominant reeds; symphonic
tonal schemes.

**SCHLICKER/Neo-Baroque**

Neo-Baroque scalings by The Schlicker Organ Company; 20th-century revival of 17th-century North
German ideals.

**ARP SCHNITGER**

Master German builder who brought the bright, incisive Werkprinzip style to its zenith.

**AEOLIAN-SKINNER**

Under the tonal direction of G. Donald Harrison, this company developed the American Classic tonal
design, characterized by firm and articulate principals, bright mixtures and French-style reeds. Its
versatility enables the American Classic to authentically perform a broad range of musical styles.

## Our vision is to be a leading global rare disease company by acquiring, developing and

## About

At Amryt Pharma, we look beyond the ordinary, unearthing scientific potential and delivering
medicines that may have the potential to change the lives of people with rare, debilitating
conditions. Through our in-depth knowledge and bold approach we combine the expertise and innovation
needed to help patients and their caregivers to access new treatments quickly and responsibly.

Amryt Pharma supports the aims and objectives of advocacy groups working across rare and
debilitating diseases to help patients and their families and carers.

This is an exciting time for Amryt Pharma. We are a successful, thriving global company poised to
achieve unparalleled results. Our success is driven and defined by the inspiring people who embody

debilitating diseases.

diseases.

patients and families.

individualized medicine more efficient, accessible, and repeatable.

[about]

APMIDA Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd. manufacturing Bulk Drug API derived from various chemicals which
have a growing demand globally. The company is linked with developed pieces of equipment of the
technology and machinery for the process of the manufacturing of the Medicine product. The state of
the art manufacturing is Drug licensed and GMP and ISO certifications. Along with this, our
production place has the following amenities:
* #### We have vast and spacious warehouse in excise free zones to do the other activities of the
  #### manufacturing of the drugs.
* #### Quality control Lab and Analytical Testing along with R&D Manufacturing facilities
* #### State Drug licenses
* #### FDA Registered

### We are Helping to Advance Health with Clinical Trials for Medicine.

APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. is a vertically integrated company that develops, manufactures, and
sells Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (API), High Potency API, and API intermediates. Our unique
research and synthesis facility reflects our commitment to research and innovation. The world-class
manufacturing facilities at APMIDA PHARMACEUTICALS Pvt. Ltd. are located in Dist. Rampur (UP)India.
These facilities are benchmarked to international standards and set to meet the rigorous quality
guideline, which is critical in achieving our global growth aspirations.

As a leading API supplier, our regulatory-approved facilities enable us to supply our partners all
over countries with a broad portfolio of products. Our expertise spans a variety of chemical
processes, Heterocyclic chemistry, Carbohydrates chemistry. Additionally, we manage enzyme
conversions for some of our products. Our manufacturing capacity for various categories ranges from
500MT/year to 800MT/Year.

### Important Order Information!

**Delayed Order Fulfillment**

We all love these products or we wouldn't be here, right? But let's admit something ... the organ
business is a niche industry with a very small target market - it's not Amazon! The reality is it
has become commonplace to experience supply chain delays in getting products from the manufacturer
and shipping your order in a timely manner, regardless of your chosen shipping method. Reasons?
1. Often the items or parts needed to assemble the items are backordered or in transit, resulting
   in longer fulfillment times.
2. Many accessories items are now built by Hammond Organ Company after receipt of your order,
   assuming they have all the parts to do so. (see #1.)
3. Many items are drop-shipped by our suppliers, which often take longer than your chosen UPS
   shipping method. B3 GUYS has no control over suppliers, nor when they choose to drop-ship your
   order. (see #1. and #2.) This includes commercial freight and UPS shipping rates, policies and
   procedures.

Bottom-line: Niche industry - it is what it is, and your understanding and patience are appreciated!

**UPS** **Shipping** 

B3 GUYS ship exclusively via UPS, or commercial freight carriers when needed. B3 GUYS is not
responsible for any delayed shipments, and will not refund any charges due to shipping delays.

# [Boston Biotech Watch][4]


# [Lab Notebook Software, Bypassed By Biologists, Poses Tough Challenge For Software Developers][5]

By Steve Dickman, [CBT Advisors][6]

More than ten years ago, I stopped using paper notebooks for my writing and consulting work. As
someone who writes and thinks for a living, this was a big transition. But what a payoff I received
in return! I no longer had to refer to handwritten notes or to type them later. My typed notes
suddenly became searchable and editable. Since they are easy to access, they push me to new
conclusions and new beginnings.

Just imagine how useful such a shift would be for biologists. Unlike the typical solitary writer or
consultant, biologists work both on their own and collaboratively. Keeping their thoughts locked in
paper notebooks has got slow down the free flow of ideas both between biologists as well as inside
each one’s head. Indeed, putting biological data – in handwriting! – into a notebook that can only
be read by one person seems almost criminal. “Cloud” software platforms have already enabled faster,
more efficient collaboration in many industries and on many levels. Think [Salesforce][7],
[Dropbox][8] and [Slack][9]. Why not free the data and biologists’ early thoughts about it? Why not
let the “hive mind” of the community go to work earlier and more efficiently? Over the internet,
such sharing could break geographic boundaries and supercharge the thinking of biologists all over
the world.

Especially in the areas of biology research that have a natural affinity for digital data and
analysis – think genomics – biologists are already using online tools to record and share data. The
same is true for chemistry, where protocols and starting materials (such as chemical precursors) are
much more standardized. But in the less digitally aligned areas of biology, the shift from paper to
electronic laboratory notebooks and similar online tools has been slow, sometimes glacially so. When
it comes to their personal lives, the same biologists are emailing, texting and Slacking with the
rest of us. But for many if not most biologists, when it comes to recording or sharing data, unless
the lab procedure is performed by robots, the front end of the data collection process still looks
like it did decades ago. Fresh data is recorded on paper or locked up within individual pieces of
laboratory equipment. Then, later, perhaps, it gets transcribed into a sanitized version of
biological reality.

The push for widespread electronic lab notebook (ELN) use is just beginning in biology. (The fact
that these software tools are still even called “electronic lab notebooks” points to the fact that
adoption has been repeatedly attempted – and has repeatedly failed – ever since “electronic” was the
term for what we now call “online.”) One company I know performed an analysis that showed that
electronic data recording and workflow management tools has only penetrated 8% of biology labs. Even
if the actual number is larger – several industry-based biologists I asked said that 8% sounded low
– the opportunity is undoubtedly huge. Consequently, a number of small and big software providers
have plunged into this messy world, each hoping to convert biologists to a new paradigm or, better
yet, to capture a mass movement that they believe is already underway. Some investors, including the
Silicon Valley heavyweight firm [Andreessen Horowitz][10], have [announced a bold and public stake
in the “clouding” of biology][11], as they call it, and promising big productivity and ease-of-use
gains from that. The way that role model companies such as Salesforce and Dropbox have taken over
other verticals, would certainly point to possible or even dramatic improvements. Seen in this
light, the progress of the early entrants into ELN field would seem to be the leading indicators for
when biology will shift more of its daily practice to the cloud and how completely and efficiently
that can happen.

This piece aims to answer these key questions: Why has change been so slow? How is that starting to
shift? And for what I believe to be at least a $10 billion question: will this transition happen
quickly and powerfully enough to reward the companies, including those in the portfolios of
investors like Andreessen Horowitz, currently hoping to capitalize on it?

**Adoption is a tough slog **

The challenges in converting biologists to cloud tools fall into a number of categories. To me, they
break down like this:

***Inertia and lack of immediate value:* **What has made Salesforce work in customer relations
management, for example, is the obvious utility of the platform at local scale but especially
globally. By contrast, at this early point in the ELN adoption curve, there is a lot of inertia
retarding adoption and little history of productivity gains. One entrepreneurial molecular
geneticist I know, currently working as a prod ### Menu

more efficient collaboration in many industries and on many levels. Think [Salesforce][7],

let the “hive mind” of the community go to work earlier and more efficiently? Over the internet,
such sharing could break geographic boundaries and supercharge the thinking of biologists all over
the world.

analysis – think genomics – biologists are already using online tools to record and share data. The
same is true for chemistry, where protocols and starting materials (such as chemical precursors) are
much more standardized. But in the less digitally aligned areas of biology, the shift from paper to
electronic laboratory notebooks and similar online tools has been slow, sometimes glacially so. When
it comes to their personal lives, the same biologists are emailing, texting and Slacking with the
rest of us. But for many if not most biologists, when it comes to recording or sharing data, unless
the lab procedure is performed by robots, the front end of the data collection process still looks
like it did decades ago. Fresh data is recorded on paper or locked up within individual pieces of
laboratory equipment. Then, later, perhaps, it gets transcribed into a sanitized version of
biological reality.

have plunged into this messy world, each hoping to convert biologists to a new paradigm or, better

Driving change by empowering women impact entrepreneurs
The Cartier Women's Initiative is an annual international entrepreneurship program that aims to
drive change by empowering women impact entrepreneurs. Founded in 2006, the program is open to
women-run and women-owned businesses from any country and sector that aim to have a strong and
sustainable social and/or environmental impact.

### Awards

Our regional and thematic awards recognize and fund talented impact entrepreneurs from around the
world who are leveraging business as a force for good.

### Fellowship

The fellowship aims to provide our fellows with peer-, industry- and academic-based educational
programming for skills and leadership development and business growth.

[ Learn More ][29]

The community gives fellows lifelong access to a vibrant group of impact leaders, creating

We foster meaningful conversations through storytelling, data sharing and research partnerships.

### 20 years of impact

In every corner of the world, women are igniting change. When these sparks converge, they light the
path to a brighter future. For two decades, we have proudly brought these changemakers together.

[ Discover More ][35]

### Introducing the 2026 Fellows

Our 2026 fellows were announced on March 26, 2026. Representing nine regions and one thematic award,
these 30 impact entrepreneurs will join us for the awards ceremony in Bangkok, Thailand on June 10,
2026.

[ Learn More ][37]
[[mariam-kresse.jpeg]][38]

Since 2006, Cartier Women’s Initiative has supported 330 fellows from 66 countries. 82% of recent
fellows attribute concrete outcomes to the Cartier Women’s Initiative’s support, networks,
communications and events. Discover more in our 2025 Impact Report.

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

## Checking Accounts

Choose the [checking account][52] that works best for you. See our [Chase Total Checking^{®}][53]
offer for new customers. Make purchases with your debit card, and bank from almost anywhere by
phone, tablet or computer and more than 14,000 ATMs and 5,000 branches.

## Savings Accounts & CDs

It’s never too early to begin saving. [Open a savings account][54] or open a Certificate of Deposit
([see interest rates][55]) and start saving your money.

## Credit Cards

Chase [credit cards][56] can help you buy the things you need. Many of our cards [offer rewards][57]
that can be redeemed for [cash back][58] or [travel-related][59] perks. With so many options, it can
be easy to find a card that matches your lifestyle. Plus, with Credit Journey you can get a [free
credit score][60]!

## Mortgages

Apply for a [mortgage][61] or [refinance your mortgage][62] with Chase. View today’s [mortgage
rates][63] or calculate what you can afford with our [mortgage calculator][64]. Visit our [Education
Center][65] for homebuying tips and more.

## Auto

[Chase Auto][66] is here to help you get the right car. Apply for [auto financing][67] for a new or
used car with Chase. Use the [payment calculator][68] to estimate monthly payments. Check out the
[Chase Auto Education Center][69] to get car guidance from a trusted source.

## Chase for Business

With [Chase for Business][70] you’ll receive all-in-one services and guidance from a team of
business professionals. Explore [business checking][71], simplify payments acceptance with [merchant
services][72], and consider [small business loans][73] or [business credit cards][74] for help with
growth. You can also visit our [business resource center][75].

## Sports & Entertainment

Chase gives you access to unique sports, entertainment and culinary events through [Chase
Experiences][76] and our exclusive partnerships such as the [US Open][77], [Madison Square
Garden][78] and [Chase Center][79].

## Chase Security Center

Our [suite of security features][80] can [help you protect][81] your info, money and give you peace
of mind. See how we're dedicated to helping [protect you][82], your accounts and your loved ones
from [financial abuse][83]. Also, [learn about the common tricks scammers are using][84] to help you
stay one step ahead of them. If you see unauthorized charges or believe your account was compromised
contact us right away to [report fraud][85].

## About Chase

Chase serves millions of people with a broad range of products. [Chase online][86] lets you manage
your Chase accounts, view statements, monitor activity, pay bills or transfer funds securely from
one central place. To learn more, visit the [Banking Education Center][87]. For questions or
concerns, please contact [Chase customer service][88] or let us know about [Chase complaints and
feedback][89]. View the [Chase Community Reinvestment Act Public File][90] for the bank’s latest CRA
rating and other CRA-related information.

## Investing by J.P. Morgan

Partner with a global leader who puts your financial needs first. [Invest on your own][91] or [work
with an advisor][92] — we have the [products][93], [technology][94] and [investment education][95],
to help you grow your wealth. Visit a J.P. Morgan [Wealth Management Branch][96] or check out our
latest online investing [features][97], [offers, promotions, and coupons][98].

Since 1986, extraordinary customer service and Allen Organ Company’s innovative instruments have
been a hallmark of Church Organ Associates, Inc. Our dedicated staff is committed to providing
churches, schools, concert halls, and residences with the highest level of customer satisfaction,
sales, installation, and service.

meticulously crafted organs in Macungie, Pennsylvania, since 1937. The cornerstones of their
business are quality, craftsmanship, and technological superiority which have been experienced by
parishioners around the globe. Today more than 80,000 Allen Organs are in service worldwide.

We’re proud to serve our neighbors throughout Texas and Oklahoma. Our team of musicians and

Made with intricate craftsmanship for the highest musical quality possible, our church organ
installations look just as beautiful as they sound.

[Our Gallery][20]

Our results speak for themselves: on budget, quality workmanship, and tonal excellence. Call

# Church Organ Associates

Allen Organ dealer since 1986.

Incomparable Sound.

Enduring Quality.

Unparalleled Support.

Since 1986, extraordinary customer service and Allen Organ Company’s innovative instruments have
been a hallmark of Church Organ Associates, Inc. Our dedicated staff is committed to providing
churches, schools, concert halls, and residences with the highest level of customer satisfaction,
sales, installation, and service.

## Certified Allen Organ Dealer

We are proud to partner with the world-famous Allen Organ Company. This American-owned company has
meticulously crafted organs in Macungie, Pennsylvania, since 1937. The cornerstones of their
business are quality, craftsmanship, and technological superiority which have been experienced by
parishioners around the globe. Today more than 80,000 Allen Organs are in service worldwide.

[View all organs][18]

## About Us

Learn how Church Organ Associates, Inc. can bring joy to your parishioners and guests through the
turn-key installation and careful maintenance of the world’s most chosen organ—Allen.

[Our story][19]

## Communities Served

We’re proud to serve our neighbors throughout Texas and Oklahoma. Our team of musicians and
certified organ technicians are eager to uplift music ministries throughout the states they call
home.

## Stunning Showcases

Made with intricate craftsmanship for the highest musical quality possible, our church organ
installations look just as beautiful as they sound.

### When static 3D models are no longer sufficient

There comes a point when static 3D models are no longer sufficient to reflect the complexity of
human biology.

As research questions evolve towards systemic effects, multi‑organ interactions, and
regulator‑relevant outputs, more advanced fluidic models are needed to deliver unique insight.

[Read the case story][70]

## PhysioMimix^{®} Core: Mimics human physiology like no other

PhysioMimix Core models human-specific biology, which animals lack. Unlock effects that manifest
only in human tissue to improve the accuracy and efficiency of drug discovery
* Human-relevant, translatable data
* Single-, multi-organ and higher throughput capabilities
* Flexible and customizable
* Easy to adopt, simple to use
* Broad drug modality compatibility, including monoclonal antibodies, oligonucleotides and
  traditional small molecules

# Content Organs USA

Content Organs has a long history in the USA. We are very pleased to work together with several
Content Organs dealers. The entity **Content Digital Organs USA** is the authorized Content USA
Importer and is responsible for the contact between Content Organs and the several dealers and
service engineers around the United States.

Mr. **Dean Mack** is head of **Content Digital Organs USA** and is the official Content Importer.
After his training and certification at the Content Organs headquarters in Ermelo (the Netherlands),
Dean became the official Content importer for Content effective April 2023. [Learn more about
Content Organs! »][9]

[Content USA Dealers (3)]

# Our USA importer

Dean Mack is the president/owner of Montana Church Organs, LLC, doing business as Content Digital
Organs USA.  Dean started his company in 2014 when he was associated with another digital organ
builder.  Dean’s interest in pipe organs started at an early age after attending Mass at St.
Helena’s Cathedral. Dean started learning organ on his own, and he played his first church service
when he was 10 years old. His interest with organs expanded to include pipe, electronic, and hybrid
organs. He is proud of his home organ installation which includes 10 ranks of windblown pipework
connected with his three-manual digital instrument. 

 

Dean is the organist at Covenant United Methodist Church in Helena and has served as an organist and
substitute organist for many church denominations in the greater Helena area.

 

Dean is pleased to be associated with Content Organs and is glad to assist organists and places of
worship to select the best instrument to meet their specific musical needs. Dean will share guidance
and information to select the right instrument available to meet the intended audiences’ needs.
[Contact Dean Mack for more information! »][10]

[VanBraakFotografie - Content Organs NL - Mr. Dean Mack-4876]

# Extensive organ series

**Digital Organs | Virtual Pipe Organs | Church Organs**

Content Organs is a leading digital organ builder. The Dutch-based company has a long history as a
builder of [digital organs][11], [church organs][12] and [Virtual Pipe Organs (Hauptwerk)][13].

 

The organs are characterized by a completely unique sound experience. Content Cambiare (Hauptwerk)
organs can be recognized by their high-quality reproduction of real pipe organs. With the Content
Cambiare Hauptwerk Series, famous church organs are within reach for both the professional organist
and the amateur organ lover. [Learn more about Content Organs »][14]

[Concerto Jubileo 40 - 2(2)913]

# Content Organs USA

Content Organs has a long history in the USA. We are very pleased to work together with several
Content Organs dealers. The entity **Content Digital Organs USA** is the authorized Content USA
Importer and is responsible for the contact between Content Organs and the several dealers and
service engineers around the United States.

Mr. **Dean Mack** is head of **Content Digital Organs USA** and is the official Content Importer.
After his training and certification at the Content Organs headquarters in Ermelo (the Netherlands),
Dean became the official Content importer for Content effective April 2023. [Learn more about
Content Organs! »][9]

[Content USA Dealers (3)]

# Our USA importer

Dean Mack is the president/owner of Montana Church Organs, LLC, doing business as Content Digital
Organs USA.  Dean started his company in 2014 when he was associated with another digital organ
builder.  Dean’s interest in pipe organs started at an early age after attending Mass at St.
Helena’s Cathedral. Dean started learning organ on his own, and he played his first church service
when he was 10 years old. His interest with organs expanded to include pipe, electronic, and hybrid
organs. He is proud of his home organ installation which includes 10 ranks of windblown pipework
connected with his three-manual digital instrument. 

 

Dean is the organist at Covenant United Methodist Church in Helena and has served as an organist and
substitute organist for many church denominations in the greater Helena area.

 

Dean is pleased to be associated with Content Organs and is glad to assist organists and places of
worship to select the best instrument to meet their specific musical needs. Dean will share guidance
and information to select the right instrument available to meet the intended audiences’ needs.
[Contact Dean Mack for more information! »][10]

builder of [digital organs][11], [church organs][12] and [Virtual Pipe Organs (Hauptwerk)][13].

 

The organs are characterized by a completely unique sound experience. Content Cambiare (Hauptwerk)
organs can be recognized by their high-quality reproduction of real pipe organs. With the Content
Cambiare Hauptwerk Series, famous church organs are within reach for both the professional organist
and the amateur organ lover. [Learn more about Content Organs »][14]

## Whatever Challenge Your Organ Presents, You Don’t Have to Face It Alone.

From emergency repairs to complete organ replacement, every project begins with understanding your
church’s goals—not selling a product.

We help churches:

• Restore aging pipe organs
• Improve worship with digital technology
• Expand existing instruments
• Preserve historic resources
• Plan wisely for future generations

[[Allen Organs logo]][29]

## Serving Churches, Not Just Installing Organs.

Since 1977, our mission at Daffer has remained remarkably simple:

Help churches strengthen worship through beautiful, reliable music.

Every recommendation we make begins with one question:

***“What is best for this congregation?”***

## We Know Choosing an Organ Can Feel Overwhelming

Whether your instrument is unreliable, your pipe organ needs major repairs, or your church is
beginning a once-in-a-generation replacement project, it’s natural to have questions.

You may be wondering:
* Can our current organ be saved?
* Should we rebuild or replace?
* How do we balance stewardship with quality?
* Will this serve the next generation?
* Who can we truly trust?

We’ve helped hundreds of churches answer those same questions with confidence.

## Proven Stability & Long-Term Commitment

Whether your needs involve new instruments, pipe additions, rebuilding, service, or audio
enhancements, Daffer provides a **seamless, integrated approach** from concept to completion.

## Experience That Gives You Confidence

Every member of our team specializes in helping churches make informed decisions—not pressured ones.

Whether your project is large or small, you’ll receive thoughtful guidance, transparent
recommendations, and craftsmanship that reflects the importance of your ministry.

## Churches Choose Daffer Because…

✔ We listen before we recommend.

✔ We respect your budget.

✔ We understand church leadership.

✔ We support you long after installation.

✔ We value relationships more than transactions.

✔ We believe every church deserves beautiful worship.

## Beautiful Worship Doesn’t Begin With an Organ.

It begins with people.

Pastors. Organists. Choirs. Volunteers. Congregations.

Our role is simply to help your ministry flourish through music.

Whether your church needs a simple repair or a transformational new instrument, we’d be honored to
walk alongside you.

**Let’s begin the conversation.**

## Whatever Challenge Your Organ Presents, You Don’t Have to Face It Alone.

From emergency repairs to complete organ replacement, every project begins with understanding your
church’s goals—not selling a product.

We help churches:

• Restore aging pipe organs
• Improve worship with digital technology
• Expand existing instruments
• Preserve historic resources
• Plan wisely for future generations

[[Allen Organs logo]][29]

## Serving Churches, Not Just Installing Organs.

Since 1977, our mission at Daffer has remained remarkably simple:

Help churches strengthen worship through beautiful, reliable music.

Every recommendation we make begins with one question:

***“What is best for this congregation?”***

## We Know Choosing an Organ Can Feel Overwhelming

Whether your instrument is unreliable, your pipe organ needs major repairs, or your church is
beginning a once-in-a-generation replacement project, it’s natural to have questions.

You may be wondering:
* Can our current organ be saved?
* Should we rebuild or replace?
* How do we balance stewardship with quality?
* Will this serve the next generation?
* Who can we truly trust?

We’ve helped hundreds of churches answer those same questions with confidence.

## Proven Stability & Long-Term Commitment

Whether your needs involve new instruments, pipe additions, rebuilding, service, or audio
enhancements, Daffer provides a **seamless, integrated approach** from concept to completion.

## Experience That Gives You Confidence

Every member of our team specializes in helping churches make informed decisions—not pressured ones.

Whether your project is large or small, you’ll receive thoughtful guidance, transparent
recommendations, and craftsmanship that reflects the importance of your ministry.

## Churches Choose Daffer Because…

✔ We listen before we recommend.

✔ We respect your budget.

✔ We understand church leadership.

✔ We support you long after installation.

✔ We value relationships more than transactions.

✔ We believe every church deserves beautiful worship.

## Beautiful Worship Doesn’t Begin With an Organ.

It begins with people.

Pastors. Organists. Choirs. Volunteers. Congregations.

Our role is simply to help your ministry flourish through music.

Whether your church needs a simple repair or a transformational new instrument, we’d be honored to
walk alongside you.

**Let’s begin the conversation.**

# DELEIKA® Drehorgeln Manufaktur und Museum in Dinkelsbühl

**Weltweiter Vertrieb von handgemachten Drehorgeln mit Notenband- und Memorysteuerung**

In unserer Manufaktur in Dinkelsbühl (Bayern) fertigen wir mit viel Liebe und in reiner Handarbeit
eine Vielzahl originaler DELEIKA® Drehorgeln. Wählen Sie zwischen klassischen Modellen mit
Notenbändern oder unserer innovativen Memorysteuerung.

Unsere Drehorgeln im Überblick:
* [Drehorgeln mit Notenband und Memorysteuerung][37]
* [Drehorgeln mit Memorysteuerung][38]
* [Drehorgeln mit Notenbandsteuerung][39]
* [Drehorgelautomaten][40]

Der gesamte Herstellungsprozess erfolgt **komplett manuell – ohne Automatisierung**. In Kombination
mit traditioneller Bauernmalerei oder edlen Intarsien entstehen so funktionale Kunstwerke mit
Charakter.

## Barrierefreie Technik für uneingeschränkte Spielfreude

Unsere Technik berücksichtigt **besonders die Bedürfnisse von Menschen mit Behinderungen und
Einschränkungen**, um eine möglichst einfache und komfortable Bedienung zu gewährleisten. Daher
zählen zahlreiche Einrichtungen für Menschen mit Demenz sowie körperlicher oder geistiger
Behinderung zu unseren langjährigen Kunden.

Bereits im Jahr 2023 haben wir eine neue elektronische Steuerung eingeführt, die die Bedienbarkeit
**erheblich erweitert – insbesondere für Menschen mit Behinderungen**. Gleichzeitig wurde die
Speicherbegrenzung für Liedgut aufgehoben, sodass nun noch mehr persönliche Wunschstücke gespeichert
werden können.

## Handwerk und Innovation seit 1981

DELEIKA® steht seit über vier Jahrzehnten für **erstklassigen Service und höchste Qualität**. Seit
1996 sind wir in Dinkelsbühl ansässig und liefern unsere Orgeln weltweit aus.

Unsere neueste Innovation ist eine Konzertorgel mit fünf Registern – ein echtes Highlight für
Musikliebhaber. Besuchen Sie unsere Manufaktur samt [Drehorgel-Museum][41] und überzeugen Sie sich
vor Ort.

## Ihr Wunschstück auf Notenband oder im Memoryformat

Sie haben einen bestimmten Musikwunsch? Wir arrangieren ihn für Ihre Orgel – wahlweise auf
klassischem Notenband (auch für Fremdorgeln) oder als digitales Stück für die Memorysteuerung.

## DELEIKA® Drehorgeln – mehr als nur Instrumente

**Unzählige Melodien** stehen für Ihre Memory-Auswahl bereit. Stöbern Sie gerne in unseren
Liederlisten und stellen Sie sich Ihr persönliches Musikprogramm zusammen.

Auch ohne Neukauf profitieren Sie von unserem Angebot:
* **Gebrauchte Drehorgeln** mit geprüfter Qualität
* **DELEIKA®-Verleih-Service** für Veranstaltungen
* **Reparaturservice für Fremdfabrikate**:
  Kontaktieren Sie uns mit Ihrem Anliegen – ob mit originalen Ersatzteilen oder kreativen Lösungen
  bei nicht mehr produzierten Modellen, wir helfen weiter.

Käufer gebrauchter Orgeln erhalten selbstverständlich **kompetente Beratung, umfassenden Service und
persönliche Betreuung** bei der Auswahl und Inbetriebnahme.

# DELEIKA® Drehorgeln Manufaktur und Museum in Dinkelsbühl

**Weltweiter Vertrieb von handgemachten Drehorgeln mit Notenband- und Memorysteuerung**

In unserer Manufaktur in Dinkelsbühl (Bayern) fertigen wir mit viel Liebe und in reiner Handarbeit
eine Vielzahl originaler DELEIKA® Drehorgeln. Wählen Sie zwischen klassischen Modellen mit
Notenbändern oder unserer innovativen Memorysteuerung.

Unsere Drehorgeln im Überblick:
* [Drehorgeln mit Notenband und Memorysteuerung][37]
* [Drehorgeln mit Memorysteuerung][38]
* [Drehorgeln mit Notenbandsteuerung][39]
* [Drehorgelautomaten][40]

Der gesamte Herstellungsprozess erfolgt **komplett manuell – ohne Automatisierung**. In Kombination
mit traditioneller Bauernmalerei oder edlen Intarsien entstehen so funktionale Kunstwerke mit
Charakter.

## Barrierefreie Technik für uneingeschränkte Spielfreude

Unsere Technik berücksichtigt **besonders die Bedürfnisse von Menschen mit Behinderungen und
Einschränkungen**, um eine möglichst einfache und komfortable Bedienung zu gewährleisten. Daher
zählen zahlreiche Einrichtungen für Menschen mit Demenz sowie körperlicher oder geistiger
Behinderung zu unseren langjährigen Kunden.

Bereits im Jahr 2023 haben wir eine neue elektronische Steuerung eingeführt, die die Bedienbarkeit
**erheblich erweitert – insbesondere für Menschen mit Behinderungen**. Gleichzeitig wurde die
Speicherbegrenzung für Liedgut aufgehoben, sodass nun noch mehr persönliche Wunschstücke gespeichert
werden können.

## Handwerk und Innovation seit 1981

DELEIKA® steht seit über vier Jahrzehnten für **erstklassigen Service und höchste Qualität**. Seit
1996 sind wir in Dinkelsbühl ansässig und liefern unsere Orgeln weltweit aus.

Unsere neueste Innovation ist eine Konzertorgel mit fünf Registern – ein echtes Highlight für
Musikliebhaber. Besuchen Sie unsere Manufaktur samt [Drehorgel-Museum][41] und überzeugen Sie sich
vor Ort.

## Ihr Wunschstück auf Notenband oder im Memoryformat

Sie haben einen bestimmten Musikwunsch? Wir arrangieren ihn für Ihre Orgel – wahlweise auf
klassischem Notenband (auch für Fremdorgeln) oder als digitales Stück für die Memorysteuerung.

## DELEIKA® Drehorgeln – mehr als nur Instrumente

**Unzählige Melodien** stehen für Ihre Memory-Auswahl bereit. Stöbern Sie gerne in unseren
Liederlisten und stellen Sie sich Ihr persönliches Musikprogramm zusammen.

Auch ohne Neukauf profitieren Sie von unserem Angebot:
* **Gebrauchte Drehorgeln** mit geprüfter Qualität
* **DELEIKA®-Verleih-Service** für Veranstaltungen
* **Reparaturservice für Fremdfabrikate**:
  Kontaktieren Sie uns mit Ihrem Anliegen – ob mit originalen Ersatzteilen oder kreativen Lösungen
  bei nicht mehr produzierten Modellen, wir helfen weiter.

Käufer gebrauchter Orgeln erhalten selbstverständlich **kompetente Beratung, umfassenden Service und
persönliche Betreuung** bei der Auswahl und Inbetriebnahme.

Digital Piano App is a free and simple virtual piano that you can play in any web browser.

## How to play our online piano

You can play the digital piano app by clicking with your mouse. Or you can use the letter keys on
your keyboard. Pressing your R key will play middle C, pressing 5 will play C-sharp, T will play D,
and so on. You can find a full list of how the computer keys map to the piano keys in the chart
below.

[Chart showing how the keyboard keys map to the piano keys]

The arrangement is in two pairs of rows - the higher notes are played using the first two rows of
your keyboard, and the lower notes are played using the third and fourth rows of your keyboard.

Alternatively, you may have a midi keyboard. If you connect that to your computer, the digital piano
app will recongise your device, and you can play as normal.

The online piano is also compatible with mobile and tablet devices. We recommend holding your
devices in landscape orientation to make the best use of the available space.

** Can't hear any sound?**

If you're using an Apple iOS device, please ensure your phone ringer volume is not in silent mode
and that *do not disturb* is not enabled.

The Problem With Analysts

## They're slow. They're expensive.
## *And they're keeping your data hostage.*

01
They're wrong more than you think.

Analysts aren't oracles. They're people working with the same public data you could access yourself
— just a few weeks later, after three rounds of internal review, dressed up in a 60-page PDF with a
lot of confident language.

**The data doesn't get better in the meantime.** A patent expiry date is a patent expiry date. The
FDA docket says what it says. You're not paying for insight. You're paying for someone else's
reading of the same primary sources — with their biases baked in.

"Analysts add interpretation. Not always accuracy."
02
By the time it lands, it's old.

Drug markets move fast. A competitor files an ANDA. A court issues an injunction. A biosimilar gets
the nod. These things happen on a Tuesday.

**Your quarterly report arrives on a Thursday — three months later.** You've already missed the
window. The early-mover advantage went to whoever was watching the primary data in real time. Not
waiting for someone to write it up nicely.

"Markets don't wait for your next briefing."
03
And you never see the raw data.

Here's the part nobody talks about. You get the conclusion. You don't get the spreadsheet.

**You can't check their working. You can't run your own cut. You can't take it with you when the
contract ends.** The data is theirs. The methodology is theirs. If you want to ask a different
question than the one they answered, that's a new engagement — new invoice, new wait.

"A black box isn't analysis. It's dependency."
The data analysts use
to make their calls?
*It's right here.*

DrugPatentWatch pulls directly from primary sources — the USPTO, FDA Orange Book, ANDA filings,
litigation records, patent registers across 134 countries. **Every source an analyst would use.
Updated daily. No middleman.**

You form your own view. You run your own queries. You export everything and it's yours —
permanently. When the contract ends, the data doesn't disappear.

##### Welcome to the Wageningen University and Research eDepot

This is the Wageningen University and Research eDepot. In this repository we store files for
[Research@WUR][5] (our Current Research Information System), several Documentation databases and
[WUR Library Search][6] (our catalogue). You cannot search this eDepot itself.

Check the [WUR Library website][7] for a complete overview of our services.

Do you want to know more about our eDepot, please contact [servicedesk.facilities@wur.nl][8]

## Our Products & Services

### Build your own organ models

[DynamicOrgan 2 channel System][DynamicOrgan 2 channel System]

Create in vitro human disease and infection models with our [DynamicOrgan® System][100]. Our system
enables physiological cell and tissue culture to help you reproduce all our standard organ models or
build completely new ones. With the DynamicOrgan® System you can reproduce key organ functions,
including the vasculature, immune cells, microbiome and pathogens. The system components, such as
our biochips and pump, integrate seamlessly into your existing workflows, are easy to use and don’t
require capital expenditure.

# Welcome to Farmson Basic Drugs Global Leader in API Paracetamol / Acetaminophen Production

About Us

## World's #1 Paracetamol API Manufacturer with 50+ Years of Excellence

For over 50 years, Farmson Basic Drugs has been India's most trusted GMP-certified API
pharmaceutical manufacturer. As the world's largest Paracetamol API producer, we supply
acetaminophen and other pharmaceutical APIs to 400+ partners across 65+ countries.

Farmson was established in the year 1969 for manufacturing of Paracetamol through phenol route. In
the year 2000, we switched over to the PNCB route to manufacture Paracetamol. Currently, we are the
GLOBAL LEADER in API Paracetamol production.

With the motto of self-reliance, in 2005, we set up a plant in Jhagadia-Bharuch with backward
integration for manufacturing of PAP from PNCB wherein we were the first and only company producing
PAP through Hydrogenation process. For manufacturing API Paracetamol, we commissioned Unit-II in
2012, while in 2018, Unit-I was renovated & restructured to further expand our capacity.

Today, We Are

* [icon]
  
  ### Backwardly integrated for PAP
* [icon]
  
  ### Forward integration for DC
* [icon]
  
  ### Only Paracetamol Manufacturer with RC Logo (2023)
* [icon]
  
  ### 23% Global Market Share in API Paracetamol
* [icon]
  
  ### 40% Domestic India Market Share in Paracetamol API

## Our Pharmaceutical API Products & Formulations

### Paracetamol API – Multiple Grades for Every Formulation

Paracetamol, being the safest & the most affordable Analgesic & Antipyretic drug, is used for
treating fever, flu, body pain and cold.

### Paracetamol DC Granules – Directly Compressible for Tablet Production

Our DC provides drum-to-feeder compression/encapsulation solutions that are both economically sound
and operationally simple.

### New APIs – Theophylline, Rivaroxaban, Folic Acid & More

Introducing Our Latest API Range from Units 4 & 5

### Caffeine Anhydrous API

EU GMP Certified, 600 MT/Month

# A chat app that puts you first

Made in Sweden

Fluxer is a free and open source instant messaging and VoIP chat app built for friends, groups, and
communities.

[Download Fluxer][25][Open in browser][26]
[Try Fluxer without an email in 30 seconds][27]
[Fluxer desktop interface]
[Fluxer mobile interface]

## What's available today

All the basics you expect, plus a few things you don't.

### Messaging

DM your friends, chat with groups, or build communities with channels.
* Full Markdown support in messages
* Private DMs and group chats
* Organized channels for communities
* Share files and preview links

### Voice and video

Hop in a call with friends or share your screen to work together.
* Join from multiple devices at once
* Built-in screen sharing
* Noise suppression and echo cancellation
* Mute, deafen, and camera controls

### Moderation tools

Keep your community running smoothly with roles, permissions, and logs.
* Granular roles and permissions
* Moderation actions and tools
* Audit logs for transparency
* Webhooks and bot support

### Search and quick switcher

Find old messages or jump between communities and channels in seconds.
* Search message history
* Filter by users, dates, and more
* Quick switcher with keyboard shortcuts
* Manage friends and block users

### Customization

Add custom emojis, save media for later, and style the app with custom CSS.
* Upload custom emojis and stickers
* Save images, videos, GIFs, and audio
* Custom CSS themes
* Compact mode and display options

[Learn more][28]

### Self-hosting

Run the Fluxer backend on your own hardware and connect with our apps.
* Fully open source (AGPLv3)
* Host your own instance
* Use the desktop client (mobile coming soon)
* Switch between multiple instances

## Voice regions

Sixteen voice regions across six continents. Voice and video calls connect through the region
closest to you.

# A chat app that puts you first

Made in Sweden

Fluxer is a free and open source instant messaging and VoIP chat app built for friends, groups, and
communities.

[Download Fluxer][25][Open in browser][26]
[Try Fluxer without an email in 30 seconds][27]
[Fluxer desktop interface]
[Fluxer mobile interface]

## What's available today

All the basics you expect, plus a few things you don't.

### Messaging

DM your friends, chat with groups, or build communities with channels.
* Full Markdown support in messages
* Private DMs and group chats
* Organized channels for communities
* Share files and preview links

### Voice and video

Hop in a call with friends or share your screen to work together.
* Join from multiple devices at once
* Built-in screen sharing
* Noise suppression and echo cancellation
* Mute, deafen, and camera controls

### Moderation tools

Keep your community running smoothly with roles, permissions, and logs.
* Granular roles and permissions
* Moderation actions and tools
* Audit logs for transparency
* Webhooks and bot support

### Search and quick switcher

Find old messages or jump between communities and channels in seconds.
* Search message history
* Filter by users, dates, and more
* Quick switcher with keyboard shortcuts
* Manage friends and block users

### Customization

Add custom emojis, save media for later, and style the app with custom CSS.
* Upload custom emojis and stickers
* Save images, videos, GIFs, and audio
* Custom CSS themes
* Compact mode and display options

[Learn more][28]

### Self-hosting

Run the Fluxer backend on your own hardware and connect with our apps.
* Fully open source (AGPLv3)
* Host your own instance
* Use the desktop client (mobile coming soon)
* Switch between multiple instances

Sixteen voice regions across six continents. Voice and video calls connect through the region
closest to you.

therapies with clear clinical relevance, we aim to improve patient outcomes while strengthening

## “THEY COMPARE OUR ORGANS TO HIGHLY DESIRABLE AND EXCLUSIVE CARS, BUILT IN THE OLD ENGLISH
## TRADITION”

Copeman Hart, established in 1960, enjoys an international reputation for its custom built church
organs with a typical English sound and appearance. In 2011 the company was sold to the Global Organ
Group. Founder Mr Ernest Hart intended to retire in the early years of the 21st century, but before
then put enormous effort into finding a suitable successor for the company into which he had
invested a lifetime of heart and soul. He found that successor in the Global Organ Group and in
Keith Harrington, who was then managing director of Makin Organs. Both parties were entrusted with
the task of building constructively upon Mr Ernest Hart’s legacy.

### BRAND IDENTITY

Copeman Hart is compared to highly desirable and exclusive cars by organ enthusiasts: the organs are
custom built down to the very last note. Whether it concerns the stoplist, the design of the
drawknobs, the position of the thumb pistons, the style and color of the console: each detail is
decided upon in consultation with the customer. The organ is constructed using only the best
materials. Each Copeman Hart is built in the old English tradition, which can be seen in items such
as the high quality moveable rocker tabs and the moveable drawknobs originating from the pipe organ
world. Almost anything is possible within the English tradition, and it is for this reason that most
organ enthusiasts have a relationship of many years’ standing with this brand.

[copemanhart.co.uk][5]

## “THE SOUND OF EUROPEAN HISTORY MEETING TODAY’S STANDARDS”

Johannus is one of the greatest designers and builders of digital home and church organs in the
world. The company was established by Hans Versteegt in 1968. His mission was to make church organs
affordable and accessible for a broad public. Up until today, his mission has been the starting
point of all organs designed and built by Johannus.

In addition, the company locates itself within the centuries old European church organ tradition,
which facilitates a good understanding of the unparalleled dynamics of the pipe organ. Nowhere else
than in Europe is it so easy to walk into a church and be overwhelmed by the sounds of the authentic
pipe organ. This is how it has been for centuries.

In 1987, Gert van de Weerd took over the company which he then sold to his sons Marco and René van
de Weerd after a period of growth. They have led Johannus since 2009. In recent years, the organ
company has acquired a more international character, exporting its organs now to over 100 countries

### BRAND IDENTITY

Johannus is the undisputed market leader in Europe, is number three in the United States, and holds
a leading position in emerging markets such as Asia and Africa. The Johannus collection encompasses
a very broad range of instruments varying from small, affordable organs for private homes to
enormous, custom made organs for churches, cathedrals and concert halls, sold under the name
Monarke. In addition, Johannus designs and builds hybrid organ concepts, optimally combining the
qualities of an existing pipe organ with a digital organ.

Johannus is world-famous for the renowned sound quality of its instruments. This arises partly from
its own research and ongoing technological innovation, and partly from the philosophy that the
digital organ should reflect the sound of a pipe organ as closely as possible. At Johannus, a
Trumpet always sounds like a Trumpet, and a Principal is always a Principal. Johannus, like no
other, manages to convey the sound of famous pipe organs in its digital organs. This feature makes
Johannus a unique proposition across the world.

While Johannus is grounded in a rich European history, the company has always been proud to be a
leader in innovation. Time and time again the organ builder has proven itself capable of making
optimal use of the technological possibilities to best favor the quality of its organs. Innovation
is in Johannus’ DNA. It was, for instance, the first company to use side speakers in home organs and
e-paper technology to display stop names.

Flexibility in execution is a core value that gives shape to the entire breadth of Johannus’ organ
range. Even with the standard models, customers can choose their favorite color or type of wood, the
kind of pedal, and add or replace a stop. If the customer is looking for something really special,
Johannus offers a custom design solution in its Monarke range for homes, churches and concert halls.

## “WILLIS AND HARRISON COME TO LIFE IN A MAKIN”

The pedigree of Makin organs stems back to the first experiments with synthetic organ tones carried
out by Compton Organs Ltd. This company was a famous builder of electronic and pipe organs and was
blessed with a visionary founder, John Compton. As far back as the 1920s he was experimenting with
the production of synthetic organ sounds.

Eventually, Makin was established in 1970 with the takeover of part of Compton Organs Ltd. Within
this company, Compton’s experiments could be continued and further innovations could take shape. In
the 1980s, this innovative spirit produced the Bradford Digital System, which was replaced in the
1990s by digital sampling.

The organization was founded by Mr Pilling, a successful businessman with a heartfelt passion for
organs. Initially, he did successful business with paper factories; the organ was mostly a hobby.
However, he was not humble in this: he wanted to produce the best English organ. When the Global
Organ Group took over the company in 1998, the ambition remained. Makin is currently one of the
strongest brands in the United Kingdom and enjoys an excellent reputation in the international organ
world.

### BRAND IDENTITY

Makin is a renowned organ brand on an English footing. No matter which Makin organ is being played,
it is always clear that English sound and an English design are involved. The samples are derived
from a wide range of English pipe organs, including big names such as Willis and Harrison. The
translation of the English style is implemented in each individual Makin down to the last detail,
from something as trifling as a brass music holder to more eye-catching elements such as moveable
draw knobs in rows of two. To ensure optimum reproduction of the absolutely English sound, the
larger Makin organs are fitted with the Sub- and Super-couplers.

For the convenience of organ enthusiasts, Makin offers a broad range of standard models. Certain
parts of these organs can be adapted according to the customer’s wishes. For more specific wishes,
organ enthusiasts can also speak to Makin about custom design solutions.

## “WILLIS AND HARRISON COME TO LIFE IN A MAKIN”

The pedigree of Makin organs stems back to the first experiments with synthetic organ tones carried
out by Compton Organs Ltd. This company was a famous builder of electronic and pipe organs and was
blessed with a visionary founder, John Compton. As far back as the 1920s he was experimenting with
the production of synthetic organ sounds.

Eventually, Makin was established in 1970 with the takeover of part of Compton Organs Ltd. Within
this company, Compton’s experiments could be continued and further innovations could take shape. In
the 1980s, this innovative spirit produced the Bradford Digital System, which was replaced in the
1990s by digital sampling.

The organization was founded by Mr Pilling, a successful businessman with a heartfelt passion for
organs. Initially, he did successful business with paper factories; the organ was mostly a hobby.
However, he was not humble in this: he wanted to produce the best English organ. When the Global
Organ Group took over the company in 1998, the ambition remained. Makin is currently one of the
strongest brands in the United Kingdom and enjoys an excellent reputation in the international organ
world.

### BRAND IDENTITY

Makin is a renowned organ brand on an English footing. No matter which Makin organ is being played,
it is always clear that English sound and an English design are involved. The samples are derived
from a wide range of English pipe organs, including big names such as Willis and Harrison. The
translation of the English style is implemented in each individual Makin down to the last detail,
from something as trifling as a brass music holder to more eye-catching elements such as moveable
draw knobs in rows of two. To ensure optimum reproduction of the absolutely English sound, the
larger Makin organs are fitted with the Sub- and Super-couplers.

For the convenience of organ enthusiasts, Makin offers a broad range of standard models. Certain
parts of these organs can be adapted according to the customer’s wishes. For more specific wishes,
organ enthusiasts can also speak to Makin about custom design solutions.

## We are GMP+ International

GMP+ International is the world’s largest scheme for safe and sustainable animal feed. Our mission
is to enable every company in the feed chain to take responsibility for working in a safe and
sustainable way.

After contaminated feed caused several serious incidents, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) was set
up by the Dutch feed industry in 1992 as a certification scheme for feed safety. Today, GMP+
International is a not-for-profit with over 20,000 [GMP+ certified companies][51] in 90 countries.

### About Us

## WHO-GSDP Certified Global Pharmaceutical Supplier

GNH India Pharmaceuticals Limited is a WHO-GSDP certified, globally trusted pharmaceutical supplier
based in Mumbai, India. Committed to improving healthcare access worldwide, GNH India serves
hospitals, government bodies, clinical research organisations, healthcare institutions, and licensed
medical practitioners by providing over 285,000 pharmaceutical product lines — including specialty,
orphan, and hard-to-access medicines — to more than 180 countries across the globe.

[Read More][25]

### Services

## Comprehensive Solutions Beyond Supply

#### Named Patient Supply

We support patients with rare and life-threatening conditions by providing access to medicines to
meet their treatment needs, including those not approved or commercially available in their home
countries.

[ ][26]

#### Contract Manufacturing

We provide manufacturing services through WHO-GMP, US FDA, and UK MHRA approved facilities for
branded generics, vaccines, and neutral label products across multiple therapeutic areas and forms.

[ ][27]

#### Clinical Trials Supply

We supply comparator drugs, rescue medications, co-medications, and investigational medicinal
products (IMPs) with full documentation and global shipping to support clinical trials from start to
finish.

[ ][28]

#### Orphan Drug Supply

We supply orphan drugs and rare disease medicines globally through Named Patient Programs,
compassionate use, and parallel import pathways — connecting patients with critical therapies
wherever they are.

[ [Orphan drug and rare disease medicine supply – GNH India] ][29]

#### Government Supply Services

We participate in public tenders and provide direct supply of critical medicines to government
hospitals, health departments, and non-profit programs, ensuring access to essential treatments.

[ ][30]

#### Dossiers & Stability Studies

We assist with preparation of CTD/eCTD dossiers, conduct stability studies, and support BA/BE
studies to meet regulatory authority requirements in global markets.

[ ][31]

## Validated Cold Chain Shipment

Our cold chain service protects pharmaceuticals by maintaining strict temperature control during
transit. We use validated packaging, qualified logistics, and continuous monitoring to ensure every
shipment meets compliance and quality standards.

### Validated Packaging

Our packaging solutions are scientifically tested and qualified to maintain target temperatures for
extended durations, ensuring product safety from pickup to delivery.

### Global Compliance

Every shipment aligns with GDP, GMP, and international health authority guidelines to ensure
traceability, documentation, and regulatory assurance.

### In-Transit Temperature Monitoring

Shipments are continuously tracked using data loggers that monitor and record temperature conditions
throughout transit, ensuring full visibility and compliance.

# The Heritage of Hammond

[Description of Picture.]The development of the original Hammond Organ was the birth of an entire
new class of keyboard instruments: electronic keyboard instruments.  In  fact, Laurens Hammond's
original concept was for a portable instrument that would plug into one's radio for amplification; a
very interesting concept for 1934.  While he ultimately chose to develop the two manual console
Model A it is inspiring to know that, even in the early stages of development of his instrument, Mr.
Hammond saw the future.  Today's technology enables Hammond engineers to go back to those original
design concepts and blueprints and from them develop instruments that are true to the original
Hammond Organ sound and faithful to Laurens Hammond's vision.  Hammond Central is proud to offer
brand new Hammond and Leslie products along with a select few other brands that, in our opinion,
rise to the level of quality and sound to be associated with our company.

## Portable, Affordable Console Organs

The Hammond Portable New B-3 set the standard for a quality, portable console organ.  It's price
tag, however, places it beyond the budgets of many churches and players.  All of that changed with
Hammond's introduction of the modular Hammond XK Organ Systems.  Based on the Hammond XK-3/XK-3C
single manual keyboard organs, the XK Pro, Traditional, and Vintage Systems have the sound of the
B-3 with a considerable savings.  The Hammond XK-5 carries forward that tradition.  Most recently,
Hammond has raised the bar even more with the development of the two-manual Hammond XK-7D and the
single manual XK-7, giving players the choice of 4 portable and affordable two-manual consoles: [The
XK-7D Classic Organ System, the XK-7D "Stage" Organ System,][28] the XK-5 Pro System and the
XK-5/A-3 Heritage Organ.  We love the [XK-7D/XK-7][29]!  To play either one and to "feel" that
Hammond Heritage is to understand why.  Most recently, Hammond Central has added another line of
portable, affordable console instruments by [Viscount][30].  We especially like the [Viscount
Legend][31] because it has the sound and meets a price point not available in the Hammond line-up.

## Hammond History

The Hammond Organ was invented in 1934 by Laurens Hammond in Evanston, Illinois USA. Five years
later Donald Leslie invented the Leslie Speaker in Pasadena California USA, and thus the legends
were born. Their spirit of innovation and demand for excellence in sound, feel and construction live
to this very day in all our instruments. There are many imitators, but none surpass the fruit of
their genius minds.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

## Formulation & Bulk Drugs

Tablets

Available for variety of applications in different forms such as uncoated, sugar coated, film
coated, chewable and more.

Capsules

Wide range of capsules that are available as antibiotic capsules, pain killer capsules, vitamin
supplements & tonics.

Injectables

Safe and reliable injectables that are
available in both powder and liquid
form.

Dry Syrups & Suspensions

We bring to you highly reliable formulation in the form of dry syrup for effective treatment of
variety of ailments.

Eye Drops & Ear Drops

Highly effective eye and ear drops that provide quick relief. These products are available in
sterilized and safe vials.

External Preparation

Avail from us a variety of external application products including ointments, creams and
antiseptic/disinfectants.

# Healthy Life Pharma Private Limited

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is acknowledged world wide at pharma horizon, providing a broad
range of pharmaceutical formulation to cope with the necessity of ailing humanity. With its
headquarter at Mumbai (India), Healthy Life Pharma holds expertise in offering different
formulations that include injection, tablets, capsules, liquid, dry syrups, pre filled syringes,
ointments etc.

Healthy Life Pharma (P) Limited is the flagship company of Shah Group, founded by Mr. Shah in 1976.
An encouraging leader and inspiring personality, Mr. Shah has continuously looked forward to shape
the group companies into huge and dynamic enterprise.

Having three decades of experience, Healthy Life Pharma is a WHO recognized organization, which has
certifications for cGMP and ISO 9001:2000 from UKAS for productive management in developing, quality
control and operations. The firm has operations in Indian and global markets as well, where its
business is spread in more than 30 countries. An innovative global pharmaceutical entity, we are
engaged in continuous R&D activities. For its quality production support, the firm has got approvals
from several regulatory authorities of different countries.

  Small makers surfaced through public registries and social profiles, with the source of every
  listing shown so you can check it yourself.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

What makes this different from cold outreach or hiring a trade agent?

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is

## Common questions

How the marketplace works for manufacturers and distributors.

Where do the companies come from, and what makes this catalog different?

Alongside the large exporters, the catalog is built around small local and craft producers that the
big transnational marketplaces don't carry: family manufactories, distilleries, apiaries, workshops,
cooperatives and family farms. Each listing is checked against an official government business
registry (SIREN in France, CVR in Denmark, RCCM, and dozens more) or a recognized origin mark like
PDO, GI or Genuine Jersey, and sorted by category and country. That is the difference, unique local
supply you can't find elsewhere, verified at the source and actually findable.

The catalog has thousands of manufacturers, are they real companies?

Yes. Listings are sourced from public trade registries, export databases and verified business
directories across 200+ markets, and every website is checked to be live before a listing goes
public. Each profile shows trust signals you can check yourself, and we plainly mark which companies
are Verified versus listed from public sources. These are real companies, not fabricated entries.

Three things. First, manufacturers here have published exactly what markets, channels and partner
types they want, so your introduction is expected, not ignored. Second, your distributor profile is
matched against their requirements before you even hit send, so both sides already know it's a fit.
