# Le Laboratoire spécialisé dans la fabrication de solutions injectables

Depuis plus de 130 ans, les Laboratoires CDM Lavoisier, entreprise pharmaceutique française
indépendante, sont spécialisés dans la mise au point, la fabrication et la distribution de produits
injectables stériles répondant aux dernières réglementations internationales. Nous commercialisons
des médicaments injectables en ampoules, flacons et poches, et des dispositifs médicaux destinés aux
pharmacies d’officines, ainsi qu’aux hôpitaux publics et privés. Au sein de notre site industriel de
La Chaussée Saint Victor, nous fabriquons nos propres produits mais également ceux d’autres acteurs
du secteur.

[Savoir-faire]

## Fabrication et distribution de médicaments sous AMM Lavoisier

CDM Lavoisier dispose d’un portfolio de médicaments injectables couvrant différentes aires
thérapeutiques (nutrition, anesthésie réanimation, traitement de la douleur, etc…). Ces médicaments
sont fabriqués sur notre site de La Chaussée Saint Victor.

[Nos Médicaments][34]
[Façonnage]

## Fabrication de médicaments pour le compte de laboratoires pharmaceutiques et donneurs d’ordre
## publics

Fort de son savoir-faire de plus d’un siècle dans la fabrication de médicaments injectables, CDM
Lavoisier développe et produit de nombreuses solutions injectables pour le compte de tiers dans le
cadre de son activité de façonnage pharmaceutique.

[Façonnage pharmaceutique][35]

## Research News

[Electrophysiology testing reveals a gut microbe and atrial fibrillation connection][179]

Researchers discover that gut microbe-produced TMAO changes the heart’s electrical environment,
increases susceptibility to abnormal rhythms.

[Lowering gut metabolite reverses chronic kidney disease (CKD)][180]

Surprising finding negates previous belief that kidney fibrosis from CKD is irreversible.

[Cancer metabolism and anti-tumor immunity linked to staph, bacteria in breast tumors][181]

Staphylococcus (“staph”) bacteria decrease breast tumors by recruiting immune cells and suppressing
cancer metabolism, which opens the door to microbiome-targeted therapies.

quality and freshness. We are primarily a wholesale and processing facility for local Sacramento
restaurants and casinos, which allows us to pass on the savings to you.

## Over Noorlander


Orgelmakerij Noorlander is een vooruitstrevend en snel groeiend bedrijf. Met klanten door Nederland
en de gehele wereld zijn we een serieuze speler in de orgel markt.

Door onze jarenlange ervaring op het gebied van software, hardware, audio, elektronica en meubelwerk
zijn we in staat kwaliteitsorgels te bouwen. Dit doen wij door de nieuwste techniek op orgelgebied
te combineren met een persoonlijk meubel.

zijn we in staat kwaliteitsorgels te bouwen. Dit doen wij door de nieuwste techniek op orgelgebied
te combineren met een persoonlijk meubel.

### About our parent company

[ [Sekhmet_Logo] ][47]

In May 2022, [Sekhmet Pharmaventures][48] acquired a majority stake in Optimus Drugs Group of
Companies, marking a pivotal step in our evolution.

Sekhmet Pharmaventures Pvt. Ltd. (part of Gamot API Pte Ltd. based in Singapore) was formed by Asian
private equity major PAG, along with Indian private equity firms, CX Partners and Samara Capital.
The three has formed an investment platform called Gamot API Pte. Ltd. based in Singapore, with the
aim to buy stakes in fast-growing pharma companies. Sekhmet Pharmaventures continues to combine
inorganic endeavors together with organic growth activities, in order to form a leading Pharma
platform in the spaces of intermediates, API, Finished Dosage Formulations and CMO & CDMO services.

# Organon, here for her health

We are a global healthcare company with a strategy to improve the health of women throughout their
lives. Our diverse portfolio across women's health and general medicines includes therapies and
products for a wide range of conditions and diseases.

## Our vision: a better and healthier every day for every woman.

## Our areas of focus

Our portfolio encompasses more than 70 medicines across a range of areas including reproductive
health, cardiovascular disease, neurology, dermatology, autoimmune, and respiratory conditions. We
bring these important therapies to more than 140 markets around the world.

[Learn more about our focus areas][101]

### Women’s health

Through our pipeline and portfolio, we are working to deliver medicines and devices that advance the
health of women through all stages of her life journey. We focus on conditions that are unique to
women, affect her disproportionately or impact her differently, including fertility and
contraception, maternal health conditions, and vaginal health.

### General medicines

Our general medicines franchise supports patients in managing critical, chronic, and acute
conditions – including those that disproportionately affect women. Core to this franchise are our
biosimilars, which play a vital role in expanding access to essential treatments and reflect our
commitment to affordability for communities around the world.

We imagine a world where women, the backbone of a thriving and resilient society, can readily access

her.

conditions – including those that disproportionately affect women. Core to this franchise are our
biosimilars, which play a vital role in expanding access to essential treatments and reflect our
commitment to affordability for communities around the world.

solutions which meet her health needs. A world where she prospers, and so does her family, her

# Pipeline

## DEVELOPMENT ENGINE ADDRESSING UNMET NEEDS

At United Therapeutics, we are at the forefront of developing novel treatments and health
technologies for rare and life-threatening conditions with a focus on cardiopulmonary disease and
organ transplantation. Our approach combines cutting-edge science with a patient-centric focus to
create innovative therapies that make a difference.

Likewise, our organ manufacturing programs utilize advanced technology and pioneering engineering
approaches aimed at increasing the supply of transplantable organs and tissues and improving
outcomes for transplant recipients. We are focused on achieving this through a variety of methods
including xenotransplantation, allogeneic regenerative medicine, autologous regenerative medicine,
and ex-vivo lung perfusion.

Our pipeline is dynamic and evolves regularly. Please refer to our [most recent public filings][42]
for the latest updates.

Please see our [Forward Looking Statements][43] for risks and uncertainities associated with our
pipeline.

[Download the pipeline pdf][44]

## TYVASO^{®} PLATFORM

#### *TETON-1*

Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis – U.S. and Canada

Pre-Clinical Non-Registration Registration

**About IPF. **Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is a scarring disease of the lungs of an unknown
(idiopathic) cause and is the most common of the idiopathic interstitial pneumonias. IPF is
characterized by the progressive loss of the ability of the lungs to transfer oxygen into the blood,
ultimately resulting in respiratory failure and death. While the precise causes of IPF remain
unknown, IPF rarely presents before age 50 and can be associated with cigarette smoking and certain
genetic dispositions. In addition, some evidence suggests that gastroesophageal reflux (acid reflux,
or heartburn), certain viral infections, air pollution, and some exposures in the workplace may be
risk factors for IPF. [According to recent research][45], IPF is estimated to affect between 0.33
and 4.51 people per 10,000 persons worldwide. We believe there are approximately 100,000 IPF
patients in the United States.

**Study design. **TETON-1 was conducted in the United States and Canada and sought to enroll 576
patients; the study ultimately enrolled 598 patients. The primary endpoint for *TETON-1* is the
change in absolute forced vital capacity (**FVC**) from baseline to week 52. The secondary endpoints
are time to clinical worsening, time to first acute IPF exacerbation, OS, and changes in % predicted

# Pipeline

## DEVELOPMENT ENGINE ADDRESSING UNMET NEEDS

At United Therapeutics, we are at the forefront of developing novel treatments and health
technologies for rare and life-threatening conditions with a focus on cardiopulmonary disease and
organ transplantation. Our approach combines cutting-edge science with a patient-centric focus to
create innovative therapies that make a difference.

Likewise, our organ manufacturing programs utilize advanced technology and pioneering engineering
approaches aimed at increasing the supply of transplantable organs and tissues and improving
outcomes for transplant recipients. We are focused on achieving this through a variety of methods
including xenotransplantation, allogeneic regenerative medicine, autologous regenerative medicine,
and ex-vivo lung perfusion.

Our pipeline is dynamic and evolves regularly. Please refer to our [most recent public filings][42]
for the latest updates.

Please see our [Forward Looking Statements][43] for risks and uncertainities associated with our
pipeline.

[Download the pipeline pdf][44]

## TYVASO^{®} PLATFORM

#### *TETON-1*

Idiopathic Pulmonary Fibrosis – U.S. and Canada

Pre-Clinical Non-Registration Registration

**About IPF. **Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis is a scarring disease of the lungs of an unknown
(idiopathic) cause and is the most common of the idiopathic interstitial pneumonias. IPF is
characterized by the progressive loss of the ability of the lungs to transfer oxygen into the blood,
ultimately resulting in respiratory failure and death. While the precise causes of IPF remain
unknown, IPF rarely presents before age 50 and can be associated with cigarette smoking and certain
genetic dispositions. In addition, some evidence suggests that gastroesophageal reflux (acid reflux,
or heartburn), certain viral infections, air pollution, and some exposures in the workplace may be
risk factors for IPF. [According to recent research][45], IPF is estimated to affect between 0.33
and 4.51 people per 10,000 persons worldwide. We believe there are approximately 100,000 IPF
patients in the United States.

**Study design. **TETON-1 was conducted in the United States and Canada and sought to enroll 576
patients; the study ultimately enrolled 598 patients. The primary endpoint for *TETON-1* is the
change in absolute forced vital capacity (**FVC**) from baseline to week 52. The secondary endpoints
are time to clinical worsening, time to first acute IPF exacerbation, OS, and changes in % predicted
FVC, King’s Brief Interstitial Lung Disease (**K-BILD**) quality of life questionnaire, and
diffusing capacity of the lungs for carbon monoxide (**DLCO**).

**Study progress. ** In March 2026, we [announced][46] the TETON-1 study met its primary endpoint.

**Orphan drug designation. **In December 2020, the FDA granted orphan designation for treprostinil
for the treatment of IPF. In March 2022, the European Medicines Agency also granted orphan
designation for treprostinil for the treatment of IPF.

FAQ
What services do you provide?
We provide international wholesale trade support, supplier search and verification, import
coordination, international logistics, cargo transportation, warehousing services, website
development, web applications, and e-commerce solutions.
Can you find a supplier for a specific product?
Yes. Tell us what product you need, the required specifications, quantity, preferred country of
origin, and delivery destination. We will search for suitable suppliers and assess their
reliability.
Do you work directly with manufacturers?
Whenever possible, we organize direct cooperation with manufacturers and verified suppliers. This
helps improve pricing transparency, quality control, and communication.
Can you manage the entire import process?
Yes. We can support the full process, including supplier search, negotiations, contract preparation,
documentation, quality control coordination, transportation, customs-related documents, and final
delivery.
What types of transportation do you offer?
We arrange sea, air, rail, and road transportation. Multimodal delivery combining several modes of
transport is also available.
Do you provide door-to-door delivery?
Yes. Depending on the country, cargo type, and selected route, we can organize delivery from the
supplier’s location directly to your warehouse or another agreed destination.
Can you transport oversized or unusual cargo?
Yes. Oversized, heavy, fragile, valuable, and non-standard cargo can be handled individually. We
will assess the cargo specifications and propose an appropriate route and transportation method.
Can I track my shipment?
Cargo status updates can be provided throughout the transportation process. The available tracking
method depends on the carrier and type of transportation.
What documents do you handle?
Depending on the project, we can assist with foreign trade contracts, invoices, packing lists,
transport documents, certificates of conformity or quality, and customs-related documentation.
How long does international delivery take?
Delivery time depends on the origin, destination, cargo type, transportation method, customs
procedures, and current logistics conditions. After receiving your request, we will provide an
estimated timeline.
Do you develop online stores?
Yes. We develop online stores and e-commerce platforms, including integrations, automation, payment
or delivery service connections, and other functionality required by the project.

# Reuter Organ Company scales back operations

NEW PHONE NUMBER            (785) 766-0997

                   Tours are no longer available!

Reuter Organ Company has recently scaled back operations in Lawrence, Kansas. The 78,000 square-foot
building that was the company’s home since 2001 was recently sold to Harvesters, a regional Feeding
America food bank. With many key management and shop personnel concurrently anticipating retirement,
the logistics and realities of continuing operations on the same scale at a new, more
appropriated-sized facility was determined to be impractical. 

Albert Neutel, Jr, is continuing the Reuter brand on a smaller scope. All contracted projects are
being completed in a more modest, local shop. He will also continue maintenance and tuning services,
consulting services, and work on selected projects.

We appreciate the support of the innumerable church, university, and residential clients we have
served over the years. We thank you for your patronage and the cordial relationships that have
developed in the course of our endeavors. We are proud of the long legacy of Reuter instruments that
remain as a testament to our work together, and we are grateful to our devoted employees and
representatives that have made this possible.


This is a placeholder for the Yext Knolwedge Tags. This message will not appear on the live site,
but only within the editor. The Yext Knowledge Tags are successfully installed and will be added to
the website.

### Design and Construction

Reuter pipe organs are designed using traditional methods developed over centuries of practice. They
are inspired by the rich, diverse history of the instrument, without rigid adherence to one
particular style of design or construction.
[ Learn More ][10]

### Our Installations

Pipe organs are strongly associated with places of worship. In addition to playing solo literature
and use with other instruments, they accompany choral masterworks and lead congregations in the
singing of psalms, hymns and spiritual songs. Whether an organ is intended for a church, synagogue
or concert hall, Reuter instruments enhance the musical traditions of our clients.
[ Learn More ][11]

### Personalized Service

Reuter clients have always benefitted from personalized service with careful attention to detail,
drawing on a great wealth of organ building experience. Built using the finest materials available,
Reuter organs are designed to last for generations.
[ Learn More ][12]

## BFS-Technologie & bottelpack-Abfüllanlagen

Die [**BFS-Technologie**][39] ermöglicht die Herstellung, Befüllung und Versiegelung von
bruchsicheren Polymerbehältern in einem nahtlosen, vollautomatischen aseptischen Prozess bei
gleichzeitig unübertroffener Flexibilität im Behälterdesign.

[**bottelpack-Anlagen**][40] können bis zu 37.500 BFS-Behälter pro Stunde produzieren. Darüber
hinaus sind sie die platzsparendsten [aseptischen Abfüllanlagen][41] auf dem Markt, optimieren
wertvollen Platz im Reinraum und gehören damit zu den effizientesten auf dem Markt.

Aqvesme’s FDA Milestone: Expanding Mitapivat’s Reach in Thalassemia Treatment
][9]
22 January 2026
The FDA’s recent approval of Aqvesme (mitapivat) for the treatment of anemia in adults with alpha-
and beta-thalassemia marks a significant expansion for pyruvate kinase (PK) activators. By enhancing
the activity of the wild-type PK enzyme, Aqvesme improves red blood cell health and hemoglobin
levels, offering a potent oral alternative to chronic transfusions for patients regardless of their
specific genetic mutation. This broad indication underscores a major shift in metabolic regulation
therapy, requiring R&D teams to leverage deep structural intelligence to map the competitive
landscape of PK activators and identify future modification opportunities for next-generation
erythroid therapies.

The 2026 BIO International Convention, held June 22-25, 2026 at the San Diego Convention Center,
marked a pivotal moment for the biotechnology industry. With nearly 20,000 attendees from over 76
countries (43% international), the event showcased a resurgent biotech sector characterized by
record-breaking deal activity, accelerated AI adoption, and renewed investor confidence. The
convention's theme, "Driven by Purpose," underscored the industry's commitment to transforming
scientific breakthroughs into life-changing therapies. Notable highlights included a landmark $2.5

[[EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report]][19]

### [EHA 2026 | ATG vs PTCY GVHD Prophylaxis Clinical Outcome Analysis Report][20]

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in
HLA-compatible 10/10 matched unrelated donor (MUD) hematopoietic cell transplantation (HCT) has now
been directly addressed by a large, prospective randomized controlled trial presented at EHA 2026 by
Prof. Johannes Schetelig (Dresden, Germany) and co-investigators including Matthias Stelljes. The
trial — designated the GRAPPA study — concludes that ATG-based prophylaxis retains its
standard-of-care position in this specific setting, with PTCy failing to demonstrate superiority on
the primary composite endpoint. This finding is contextualized against a backdrop of registry data,
meta-analyses, and prior Phase 2/3 evidence that had generated significant debate about PTCy's
potential to displace ATG in the 10/10 MUD context.

Abstract: EHA-7202 Short: LB5009 The question of whether post-transplant cyclophosphamide (PTCy)
should replace anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG/ATLG) as the standard GVHD prophylaxis backbone in

standard of care in the relapsed/refractory setting.

## The official procurement platform of the UN system

As [mandated by the General Assembly][17], all organizations of the UN are encouraged to participate
in UNGM with a view of creating one common United Nations global procurement website.
* Access a database of more than 500,000 suppliers and individual consultants
* Publish opportunities and contract awards
* Perform due diligence, ensure suppliers are not on sanction lists
* Share and piggyback on Long-Term Agreements (LTA)
* Integrate your organization's procurement system with UNGM

[ Join as a UN staff member ][18]

Are you from an international organization (IO), not part of the UN System, but formed by treaty
under international law with its own legal personality?
* Publish opportunities and contract awards for greater visibility
* Share and access global procurement insights on our Knowledge Center

[ Join as an IO staff member ][19]

* Organize international procurement seminars with our event management module
* Showcase innovative solutions from your country

## The official procurement platform of the UN system

As [mandated by the General Assembly][17], all organizations of the UN are encouraged to participate
in UNGM with a view of creating one common United Nations global procurement website.
* Access a database of more than 500,000 suppliers and individual consultants
* Publish opportunities and contract awards
* Perform due diligence, ensure suppliers are not on sanction lists
* Share and piggyback on Long-Term Agreements (LTA)
* Integrate your organization's procurement system with UNGM

[ Join as a UN staff member ][18]

* Share and access global procurement insights on our Knowledge Center

### ABOUT US

For decades, we’ve been a trusted partner to churches across the United States and Europe,
empowering them with the finest digital organs. As a leading innovator in digital organ technology,
we bring exceptional quality and advanced features to every instrument. This ensures your worship
space has the power to inspire and ignite with every service.

Discover our rich history and unwavering dedication to serving churches like yours.

[ Learn more ][25]

### NEW VIRTUOSO DELUXE

### ORGAN GALLERIES

[[Vero Organ Series]][26]

#### [THE VERO COLLECTION][27]

The Vero Organ Series redefines church music with a blend of elegance, innovation, and
affordability. Combining exceptional sound quality with user-friendly features, Vero organs cater to
both seasoned organists and newcomers alike.

[[vanguard363]][28]

#### [THE VANGUARD COLLECTION][29]

The Vanguard Organ Series is designed for the modern setting. Vanguard organs combine realistic pipe
models with advanced modeling, delivering an expressive and dynamic playing experience.

[[virtuoso 356 dlx]][30]

#### [THE VIRTOUSO COLLECTION][31]

The Virtuoso Organ Series represents the pinnacle of digital organ artistry, delivering an
exceptional playing experience for any setting. With outstanding sound quality, versatility, and
innovative features, Virtuoso instruments are crafted to inspire musicians of all levels and styles.

[[Hybrid Pipe Organ]][32]

#### [FUSION ORGAN][33]

The Fusion Organ Series seamlessly blends the timeless beauty of a pipe organ with the innovation of
a digital organ, offering unique advantages for your church or any space seeking unmatched
versatility and sound quality.

[ See more ][34]

### WHY CHOOSE US

#### ADVANCED SOUND MODELING

Offers sophisticated sound modeling technology to recreate the behavior of pipe organs, including
articulation, voicing, and temperament

#### PROGRAMMABLE REGISTRATIONS

Provides feature to save and recall specific combinations of voices and settings, making it easier
to switch between different pieces or sections of music

#### QUALITY AND CRAFTMANSHIP

Viscount has a long-standing reputation for building high-quality, reliable instruments

#### VARIETY OF MODELS

Offers a wide range of organ models to suit different church sizes, budgets, and musical needs

### CLIENT TESTIMONIALS

"I wanted to drop a note to say how pleased I am with the custom voicing on the Sharon Chapel organ.
I haven’t yet really begun to rethink registrations or gotten too deeply reacquainted with the
instrument, but yesterday the organ sounded majestic and magical and magnificent. Velvety, rich,
warm, and clear. The congregation did not know that the voicing activities took place last week;
yet, interestingly, SO MANY commented at the coffee hour after church yesterday that the music was
spectacular. So…thank you and big accolades on behalf of everyone at All Saints Episcopal Church –
Sharon Chapel!"
Darell Rison
“The Parish of St John The Evangelist, Pocasset, Ma is extremely pleased with our new Viscount CL6
organ , and with the exceptional installation done by the team. This instrument offers all of the
stops needed to perform diverse preludes as well as those needed to accompany a soloist, the choir
and congregational singing. In addition, the ability to adjust the parameters of each stop and add
stops from the huge list of Alternative voices, allow the ability to achieve the best sound possible
for any piece. We highly recommend Viscount Organs to any church looking for a new instrument and
extend an invitation to visit St John’s to examine the installation and play our instrument.”
Bill E
"It has taken me a while to adjust to the digital nature of my organ, given that I had practiced on
a lovely pipe organ. I am now enthused about practicing. It’s wonderful to be able to practice any
time I want to, have found sounds that I really like and my pedal work has really improved. My
teacher thinks it is a very good instrument for me and encourages me to experiment with it which I
enjoy. So thanks so much for making it so easy for me to obtain.”
Julie Reich

### TRANSFORM YOUR MUSIC WITH THE INSPIRING SOUND OF DIGITAL ORGAN

Experience the rich sounds of a traditional pipe organ in a versatile, customizable, and
cost-effective digital format.

### **UWAGA! **

### STRONIE VISIT.AUSCHWITZ.ORG **

### **[czytaj więcej][11]**

Darmowe karty wstępu na zwiedzanie bez edukatora są dostępne wyłącznie poprzez rezerwację online —
najpóźniej na 7 dni przed planowaną wizytą lub do momentu wyczerpania dostępnej puli
miejsc.  [Czytaj więcej][12].

**UWAGA:** visit.auschwitz.org to jedyna oficjalna strona z kartami wstępu do Muzeum. Nie
współpracujemy w tej kwestii z żadnymi zewnętrznymi podmiotami. Muzeum nie ponosi odpowiedzialności
za anulowane rezerwacje dokonywane na innych stronach. Zdarzają się bowiem firmy, które winą za
odwołanie wycieczek obarczają Muzeum, podczas gdy same nie otrzymały potwierdzenia wniosku o
rezerwację.

Brak kart wstępu w systemie rezerwacji internetowej na dany termin i rodzaj zwiedzania (z edukatorem
lub bez) oznacza, że wszystkie dostępne w nim miejsca zostały już zarezerwowane. Karty wstępu dla
osób indywidualnych nie podlegają zmianom rezerwacji i anulacjom ze zwrotem kosztów. Prosimy o
podjęcie przemyślanej decyzji przed dokonaniem rezerwacji.

Wszyscy odwiedzający Miejsce Pamięci, muszą posiadać ze sobą imienne Karty Wstępu oraz dokument
tożsamości. Zwiedzanie Muzeum rozpoczyna się od byłego obozu Auschwitz I. Nie zaleca się zwiedzania
Muzeum przez dzieci poniżej 14 roku życia.

 

 

ZWIEDZANIE NA MIEJSCU
Zwiedzanie grupowe
Wizyta z edukatorem Muzeum dla grup zorganizowanych lub dla osób chcących zwiedzać z edukatorem na
wyłączność.
[Dalej][13]
Zwiedzanie indywidualne
Wizyta dla osób indywidualnych, dla których na miejscu organizowane jest zwiedzanie w grupie z
edukatorem Muzeum lub zwiedzanie indywidualne bez edukatora.
[Dalej][14]

 

ZWIEDZANIE ONLINE
Zwiedzanie grupowe online
Wizyta na żywo przez Internet z edukatorem Muzeum dla grup zorganizowanych lub dla osób chcących
zwiedzać z edukatorem na wyłączność. Zwiedzanie online jest dostępne wyłącznie na komputerze
stacjonarnym lub laptopie.
Urządzenia mobilne, takie jak tablet czy telefon, nie są obsługiwane.
[Dalej][15]

## HTS Organ-on-Chip + AI for Predictive Drug Discovery with Less Animal Modeling

We have developed the world’s first and market-leading organ-on-chip platform, powered by
pharmaceutical-scale engineering and advanced image-based AI. This technology addresses a critical
gap in preclinical research by providing physiologically realistic human organ models, enabling more
predictive drug discovery while reducing reliance on animal testing.

## Current methods of drug discovery and development such as 2D Culture and Microfluidic Chips are
## limited by:

Low Throughput
High Cost
Poor Imaging Support
Complicated Handling
Difficult Data Integration
Lack of tech and clinical validation

## Our organ-on-chip technology:

## Engineering the future of human-relevant drug discovery.

## High Predictive Accuracy

90% vs. 50-65% with live animals

## High Throughput Screening/Scalability

Save both time and money – 1-4 months vs upwards of 18 month

## AI driven Image based analytics

Rapid, unbiased, and high-throughput insights

## Flexibility of offerings

Off the shelf or customized options

## Prioritize the most promising drug candidates

Improve accuracy and obtain key data early in the drug discovery process

## Superior risk assessment

Avoid late-stage losses through early mechanistic insights

## Our four-core E.P.I.C. Platform learns and grows in a closed loop feedback cycle enabling highly
## scalable exploration of human biology.  

Engineering

Economical microfluidic chips and perfusion solution that balance complexity and throughput.

## HTS Organ-on-Chip + AI for Predictive Drug Discovery with Less Animal Modeling

We have developed the world’s first and market-leading organ-on-chip platform, powered by
pharmaceutical-scale engineering and advanced image-based AI. This technology addresses a critical
gap in preclinical research by providing physiologically realistic human organ models, enabling more
predictive drug discovery while reducing reliance on animal testing.

## Current methods of drug discovery and development such as 2D Culture and Microfluidic Chips are
## limited by:

Low Throughput
High Cost
Poor Imaging Support
Complicated Handling
Difficult Data Integration
Lack of tech and clinical validation

## Our organ-on-chip technology:

## Engineering the future of human-relevant drug discovery.

## High Predictive Accuracy

90% vs. 50-65% with live animals

## High Throughput Screening/Scalability

Save both time and money – 1-4 months vs upwards of 18 month

## AI driven Image based analytics

Rapid, unbiased, and high-throughput insights

## Flexibility of offerings

Off the shelf or customized options

## Prioritize the most promising drug candidates

Improve accuracy and obtain key data early in the drug discovery process

## Superior risk assessment

Avoid late-stage losses through early mechanistic insights

## Our four-core E.P.I.C. Platform learns and grows in a closed loop feedback cycle enabling highly
## scalable exploration of human biology.  

Engineering

Economical microfluidic chips and perfusion solution that balance complexity and throughput.

# Living our mission of creating healthier, happier communities globally

[Zydus Srishti][15]

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

## Major Areas of Research

[NCE Research] **NCE Research**
* Cardio-Metabolic
* Inflammation and Immunology,
* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases
[Biologics] **Biologics**
* Biosimilar Therapeutic proteins
* Biosimilar Monoclonal antibodies
* Biobetters and Novel biologics
[Vaccines] **Vaccines**
* Infectious diseases
[View More][20]

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.

## Over 29000 people impacting lives across the world

Zydus group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, India, and ranks 4th in the Indian pharmaceutical
industry. The group has manufacturing sites and research facilities spread across five states of
Gujarat, Maharashtra, Goa, Himachal Pradesh and Sikkim in India and in the US and Brazil.

Zydus’ global business has a strong presence in the regulated markets of the US, Europe (France and
Spain) and in the high profile markets of Latin America and South Africa. It is also present in a
big way in 25 other emerging markets worldwide.

## Where Innovation Shapes Healthcare Solutions

**Zydus’ Innovation programme** is spearheaded by **1500 researchers** across 19 sites, working on
differentiated medicines for the future.
From NCEs to vaccines, biosimilars and niche technologies, the group is exploring
different ideas and concepts, innovating constantly.

* Neurosciences, Oncology, Rare Diseases

## Innovation that bridges unmet healthcare needs.

[[Tablets]][21]
[

#### Twinrab^{TM} : A Breakthrough innovation in rabies PEP

World’s First Novel Rabies Monoclonal Antibodies (mAbs) cocktail containing Docaravimab and
Miromavimab, providing dual protection against rabies.

][22]
[Saroglitazar Tablets]

#### Lipaglyn - Novel drug to treat diabetic dyslipidemia, a global, unmet healthcare need.

The first NCE from an Indian research pipeline to move from the lab to the market.

[Adalimumab]

#### [Exemptia - The world’s first biosimilar of Adalimumab, the largest selling therapy globally
#### for treating auto immune disorders.][23]

Provides a new lease of life to Indian patients of inflammatory arthritis, who did not have access
to this revolutionary therapy, so far.

[VaxiFlu-4]

#### Vaxiflu-4 - India’s 1st Tetravalent Inactivated Influenza vaccine.

The vaccine provides protection from the four influenza viruses- H1N1, H3N2, Type B (Brisbane) and
Type B (Phuket).

## State-of-the-art manufacturing capabilities.

[Manufacturing]

As one of the key players amongst the pharmaceutical manufacturing companies, the group has
manufacturing capabilities across the entire pharmaceutical value chain: including formulations,
APIs, vaccines, biosimilars, complex products (transdermals, topical etc.), animal health products
and wellness products. It has more than 30 manufacturing plants worldwide including India, Brazil
and USA.
